# Support

- **Bugs and requests.** Open a
  [GitHub issue](https://github.com/saulpatinojr/HCW-HybridCloudWorks/issues/new/choose)
  from a template: **Bug report** for a problem in the code, infrastructure,
  CI or documentation, and **Feature request** for a new capability or an
  improvement.
- **Documentation.** Architecture decisions, runbooks and standards are on
  the docs site, [docs.hybridcloudworks.com](https://docs.hybridcloudworks.com).
- **Security vulnerabilities.** Never in a public issue. Report them
  privately, as [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) describes.
